page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.3xlarge is a high clock speed virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 6462C processor operating at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 12 dedicated virtual CPUs and 96.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring external cloud block storage volumes for persistent operating system and application needs. It features no hardware GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline throughput of 10 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

With its 3.3 GHz CPU clock rate combined with a generous 96.0 GB memory footprint, the configuration targets compute tasks that simultaneously demand substantial memory capacity. The high memory density relative to core count delivers efficient resource allocation for in-memory caching layers, medium relational databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and batch data processing jobs that benefit from elevated per-core clock frequencies.
